t: Spax TX countersunk self drilling woodscrews are engineered from hardened steel for reliable fastening in various timber applications. These 4.5mm x 60mm woodscrews feature a Wirox-coated finish, providing excellent corrosion resistance for both indoor and outdoor projects, such as decking or general construction. The self-drilling tip ensures immediate hold and eliminates the need for pre-drilling in softwoods, while the single thread with ground serrations allows for fast and accurate driving. A deep recess and multi-head design ensure a strong bit hold and a flush, professional finish.
b: Single Thread with Ground Serrations for Fast & Accurate Driving
No Splitting, Even Close to the Edge
